collector_ilb.Description:
The Forwarding Rule resource (of type load_balancing_scheme=INTERNAL)
that will be used as collector for mirrored traffic. The
specified forwarding rule must have is_mirroring_collector
set to true.

url.Description: The URL of the forwarding rule.

description.Description: A human-readable description of the rule.

filter.Description: A filter for mirrored traffic.  If unset, all traffic is mirrored.

cidr_ranges.Description:
IP CIDR ranges that apply as a filter on the source (ingress) or
destination (egress) IP in the IP header. Only IPv4 is supported.

direction.Description: Direction of traffic to mirror. Default value: "BOTH" Possible values: ["INGRESS", "EGRESS", "BOTH"]

ip_protocols.Description: Possible IP protocols including tcp, udp, icmp and esp

mirrored_resources.Description: A means of specifying which resources to mirror.

instances.Description: All the listed instances will be mirrored.  Specify at most 50.

url.Description: The URL of the instances where this rule should be active.

subnetworks.Description: All instances in one of these subnetworks will be mirrored.

url.Description: The URL of the subnetwork where this rule should be active.

tags.Description: All instances with these tags will be mirrored.

name.Description: The name of the packet mirroring rule

network.Description:
Specifies the mirrored VPC network. Only packets in this network
will be mirrored. All mirrored VMs should have a NIC in the given
network. All mirrored subnetworks should belong to the given network.

url.Description: The full self_link URL of the network where this rule is active.

priority.Description:
Since only one rule can be active at a time, priority is
used to break ties in the case of two rules that apply to
the same instances.

region.Description:
The Region in which the created address should reside.
If it is not provided, the provider region is used.
